newsitem.title: PANAMA: Four dead, one missing after Panama boat sinking.
newsitem.headline: Four dead, one missing after Panama boat sinking.

text.p: Four people drowned and a young girl was missing on Friday after a small boat carrying a group of 18 people sank off Panama's Caribbean coast, authorities said.

Another 13 people were plucked from the sea after the 25-foot (8 metres) craft went down in a heavy swell in the Bocas del Toro area late on Thursday, National Protection Authority Director Roberto Velasquez told Reuters.

Rescue teams called off the search for a nine-year-old girl late on Friday due to heavy seas. They would resume the search on Saturday morning but held out little hope of finding her alive, Velasquez said.
The accident occurred as the party of 18 from a Christian retreat made the short journey from Crusapin to Almirante in eastern Panama.
The nationalities of the dead and survivors was not immediately known.
